title: Protein-Packed Buddha Bowl
style: Simple, nourishing buddha bowl with roasted sweet potato and a creamy peanut dressing.
description: An easy, protein-packed buddha bowl with brown rice, chickpeas, roasted sweet potato, and a punchy peanut-maple dressing.
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Cut sweet potato in half, place on an oiled baking sheet, season with salt or steak spices, and bake for ~30 min until tender.

Make Dressing: Add peanut butter, maple syrup, balsamic vinegar, and soy sauce to a jar. Add an avocado pit (optional, for emulsifying), seal, and shake well. Alternatively, mix with a fork or immersion blender.
Assemble Bowl: Place lettuce leaves in a bowl. Top with cooked brown rice, baked sweet potato, chickpeas, cherry tomatoes, and avocado.
Drizzle generously with peanut dressing and serve.
tips: Add chili flakes or sriracha to the dressing for heat.
Great base for meal prep — keep dressing separate until serving.
Boost protein with tofu, tempeh, or edamame.
